measured_on: Windows 11, Intel i9-9880H, 64 GB RAM, NVIDIA Quadro RTX 4000 (8 GB), Ollama, 2026-10-25
note: Small exact-answer benchmarks (6 math, 3 coding, 3 literature tasks) plus a multi-step error-fixing loop and a skill-following test. A starting point, not a ranking: re-run benchmarks/task_models.py on your own machine.

coding.why: 3/3 coding tasks, and fixed all four seeded faults in the multi-step error loop. The 1.5B model passes single functions but failed the multi-step loop.

math.why: 6/6 math problems, but about three times slower. qwen2.5-coder:7b scored 5/6 and qwen3:8b scored 4/6.

literature.why: 3/3 on extraction, screening and refusing to invent a reference; 7/7 when following skills. qwen2.5-coder:7b scored 2/3.

general.why: Followed the skills in 7/7 tasks. The 1.5B model followed 5/7 and is the choice for computers with 8 GB of RAM.

not_recommended.gpt-oss:20b: The locally downloaded copy did not load in this Ollama version (GGUF metadata error). Re-download it before testing.
